# The Graphikk

> The Graphikk is a web design and development company based in Chennai, India. It builds fast, SEO-ready business websites, Shopify and WooCommerce online stores, and landing pages for businesses in Chennai and across India, with fixed prices in rupees and GST invoices.

Key facts:

- Location: Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. Meets clients in person in Chennai; works remotely with clients across India.
- Founder: Kavin Arulraj.
- Services: business websites, online stores (Shopify, WooCommerce), landing pages, custom web development, monthly SEO, Google and Meta ads management, Google Business Profile setup.
- Prices (plus 18% GST): websites from ₹40,000 (up to 50 pages), online stores from ₹50,000 (up to 50 products), landing pages from ₹20,000, SEO from ₹35,000/month, ads management from ₹30,000/month.
- Delivery: websites 2–3 weeks, online stores 4–5 weeks, landing pages 1–2 weeks.
- Languages: English and Tamil (bilingual websites available).
- Contact: thegraphikk@gmail.com, WhatsApp +91 70102 66975, https://thegraphikk.com/contact
